issues.detail: The Hebrew name נְחֶמְיָה (Nehemiah) is rendered as '尼希米雅' in Chinese, which is a non-standard transliteration; the standard is '尼希米'. However, the more significant issue is that '提斯他' (Tishatha) appears to be an addition or misplacement—the Hebrew has 'הַתִּרְשָׁתָא' (the Tirshatha, a title meaning governor), not a personal name. The Chinese '提斯他' seems to be a transliteration of 'תִּרְשָׁתָא' but incorrectly treated as a name, and '尼希米雅' is a variant of Nehemiah. The phrase '就是哈加利亞人的兒子' correctly renders 'בֶּן חֲכַלְיָה' (son of Hakaliah), but the overall rendering misidentifies the title as a name and alters the name form, which could mislead the reader about the identity of the signer.
